title: Nahm-Kirchhoff Moduli Spaces, Hyperkähler Quotient and 2D Field theories
summary: To an oriented quiver with boundary $Γ$ and a compact connected Lie group $G$ we associate a Nahm-Kirchhoff moduli space $\mathcal{M}_{\mathbb{H}}(Γ)$: solutions of Nahm's equations on the edges with Kirchhoff matching at interior vertices, modulo boundary-trivial gauge transformations. For connected $Γ$, $\mathcal{M}_{\mathbb{H}}(Γ)$ is a smooth manifold of dimension $4(|E|-|Γ_{\mathrm{int}}|)\dim G$ with a hyperkähler structure arising as an infinite-dimensional hyperkähler quotient.
